# Mocked FTC SDK coverage

**Generated by `npm run gen:coverage`. Do not edit by hand.**

Every package name and method signature here is the real one, from
[ftc-docs](https://ftc-docs.firstinspires.org) and the
[FtcRobotController](https://github.com/FIRST-Tech-Challenge/FtcRobotController) repo, so a
kid's file pastes into Android Studio unchanged.

**A lesson may not call anything that is not on this page.** `tests/content.test.ts`
enforces that. If a lesson needs something new, mock it in `src/ftc-mock/` first and
regenerate this page — which also regenerates `ftc-stubs/` for the real-javac gate.

A method marked **clock** advances the simulation by one 20 ms tick when called. Those are
the methods real FTC code polls in a loop condition, which is how
`while (opModeIsActive())` runs at the right rate. See `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.

## Device names

Fixed across every tier by CLAUDE.md. `hardwareMap.get` is case-sensitive, exactly as
on a real robot.

| Robot | Names |
|---|---|
| tank (Tiers 0-2) | `leftDrive`, `rightDrive`, `armMotor`, `clawServo`, `distanceSensor`, `colorSensor`, `imu` |
| mecanum (Tiers 3-5) | `frontLeft`, `frontRight`, `backLeft`, `backRight`, `armMotor`, `clawServo`, `distanceSensor`, `colorSensor`, `imu` |

All names: `leftDrive`, `rightDrive`, `frontLeft`, `frontRight`, `backLeft`, `backRight`, `armMotor`, `clawServo`, `distanceSensor`, `colorSensor`, `imu`.

## `com.qualcomm.hardware.rev`

### RevHubOrientationOnRobot <sub>class</sub>

Describes how the Control Hub is mounted, passed to IMU.Parameters.

- `new RevHubOrientationOnRobot(RevHubOrientationOnRobot.LogoFacingDirection, RevHubOrientationOnRobot.UsbFacingDirection)`

### RevHubOrientationOnRobot.LogoFacingDirection <sub>enum</sub>

Which way the REV logo on the hub points.

Constants: `UP`, `DOWN`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`, `FORWARD`, `BACKWARD`

### RevHubOrientationOnRobot.UsbFacingDirection <sub>enum</sub>

Which way the hub USB port points.

Constants: `UP`, `DOWN`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`, `FORWARD`, `BACKWARD`

## Deliberately not mocked

Listed so nobody has to guess. A lesson that needs one of these has to be redesigned,
or the feature has to be added to the interpreter first. The browser reports each of
these by name rather than crashing. See `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`.

- Lambdas and method references (`->`, `::`)
- try / catch / finally
- Collections: `List`, `ArrayList`, `Map`, `HashMap`, and the rest of `java.util`
- Generics beyond the `Class<T>` token `hardwareMap.get` needs
- Inner, anonymous and local classes (nested `enum` and nested `class` are supported)
- Threads, `synchronized`, reflection
- File and network I/O
- Vuforia, TensorFlow, AprilTag and any season-specific vision library
- Records, `var` patterns, sealed types
